notes.title: Animaze 1.27.12653 : New tracker on the main branch, and Animaze 2024
notes.content:

notes.title: Big update for webcam tracking users, hand tracking is here!
notes.content:
Hello Awesome Folks!

We have a big update for you today! 
Because it is Friday and we don't want to affect your weekend streaming schedule with big changes only minutes before you start streaming, it will go live on Next-Version today, and on the main branch on Monday (or more likely Tuesday)!

Here are the highlights: 

[h2]Hand tracking with just a webcam.[/h2]
We're thrilled to announce that starting today Animaze has its own internal implementation for webcam-based hand tracking, sourcing data from the well-known MediaPipe tracker from Google. 
Please give us feedback and let us know what you think. We will be fine-tuning it further.

To turn hand tracking on go to Settings-> Advanced Tracking Configuration-> Select Trackers and toggle on Hands under the Mediapipe (Default) Tracker. 
Then, to tune the behavior (how much they move and how smooth the motion is) go to  Settings-> Advanced Tracking Configuration->MediaPipe Hand Tracker.

In this first iteration, we've focused on webcam tracking users, so cannot yet be combined with the iOS face tracker: to use these new webcam-based hands for now the tracking needs to be all-webcam. If you use an iPhone for face tracking, no worries, we will be updating Animaze so you can mix them up later on. 

The foundational work for full body tracking is also done, but we had to concede there is no practical way to accommodate proper face tracking camera positioning (needs to be near), and full body tracking camera positioning (needs to be far), with a single webcam. To have a proper experience, there is a clear need for dual or multi-webcam support, and things get quite complicated. That is partially why full-body mode is not being released today. Head and hands though work just fine and are practical with just one webcam.

We know that for some of you, hand and body tracking are already part of your arsenal, and indeed they have been possible in Animaze since the start using more complex sensors, or VMC support. However, some considered that a bit of a hustle to set up, so in 2024 we are taking steps to make it radically simpler and more accessible. 



[h2]Core face tracking changes for the webcam face tracker.[/h2]
The Google Mediapipe Tracker has been getting better and better over the last year so.
That is why starting with this update forward it will become the new default tracker for Animaze webcam, not just for hands but for face as well. Please update your settings accordingly. 
If you want to still use the old face tracker version in a transitional period, you can always use the Previous Version branch.


[h2] Yearly Historical Licenses [/h2]
For those of you who prefer getting yearly pay-once-use forever license versions of Animaze rather than supporting its continuous evolution via an ongoing sub, the 2024 yearly snapshots are just around the corner too. We'll have more specific news about them in the next few days. They do include the new hand tracking, and, as always, the active long-term subscribers will get them for free.

[b][i]An important note[/i][/b] for those of you who are not subscribers, and are using Animaze 2023 historical DLCs or older: remember that starting with Monday,  to use your historical snapshot license you will have to instruct Steam to run your separate historical Animaze executable, that does not require a connection to any Animaze servers.

To do so, in the Steam client right right-click on the Animaze software, go to General, select Launch options, and select your historical license executable (2022 or 2023).
You will likely also want to migrate your settings and custom content to the Animaze 2023-specific data sub-folder.  The new hand animation support that we have built and are releasing today is, like most 2024 features,  not part of the 2023 historical license.


As always, we love hearing what you think about the new content and Animaze! Tell us what you’d like to see added to Animaze on our Discord server, email us at support[@]animaze[.]us, or message us on Twitter!

Thank you for being a part of our community, and for supporting indie engines for Avatars and VTubing. 


The Holotech Team,
Alex, Catalin and Dragos.

[list]
[*]it can't be currently combined with other face trackers  (for instance with iPhone face tracking). Naturally, this will be addressed before the official feature launch. 
[*]It works with all 3D models that are Animaze mannequin compatible: native Animaze avatars, Ready Player Me, Union Avatars, VRM (0.0 and 1.00).
[*] For most avatars you might want to start either with "face as origin" setting toggled to on, or with it off, change Reference Origin settings in Advanced Tracking Configuration->MediaPipe Tracker, to adjust the tracking offsets to your specific setup. 
[*] It does not yet work in Animaze Rooms (Animaze Multiplayer)
[*]Live2D support can be added but is currently on hold until we hear from Live2D artists information on which parameters  (and parameter ranges) they want. The sooner we receive that information, the sooner we can plan for Live2D-specific parameters to be sent out.
[/list]

notes.title: Visage Technologies Face Tracker Upgrade
notes.content:
Hello animazing community,

We're excited to bring to you Animaze with an improved webcam face-tracking library from Visage Technologies. What you'll likely notice right away is that it has less jitter and requires less smoothing, allowing you to enable a snappier mo-cap experience from your advanced tracking settings. 

We are also applying what we have learned with auto-generating avatar motions and gestures on Chatpal, to enable an improved "no-cam" mode for streamers that want to drive things with just their voice.

[h3]Desktop Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*]updated the default webcam face tracker Visage SDK, which significantly reduces tracking jitter.
[*]Animaze ChatPal updates
[list]
[*]fixed issue with the start of talking behavior on cloud voices which activated too early, the behavior should start at the right time now.
[*]fixed gestures and emotions being ignored if they are at the very start of the phrase, on very short phrases with single gesture/emotion.
[/list]
[*]updated the MToon shader for VRM 1.0, newly imported VRM 1.0 avatars should be shaded correctly now.
[*]disabled texture resizing when importing user images (for any type of customization); before, textures were clamped to the application render size.
[*]fixed Ultraleap freezing issue if you use general special actions and interrupt them with the avatar's dedicated idle.
[*]for VRM and GLB models, on import, we are removing ARKit eyes look-at blendshapes (e.g. EyeLookDownLeft) specifically for the meshes that are skinned by the eyeLeft/eyeRight joints. For VRM and GLB-sourced avatars, the eyes are animated procedurally by rotating the eye joints, applying blendshapes over this would only apply a double transform and make the end result inaccurate and/or distorted.
[*]added Animaze Webcamless Face & Body Extension (activable from Settings > Advanced Tracking Configuration > Select Trackers) which adds dynamic facial expressions and body movements to your avatar without the need for face or body trackers. Some movements are derived or applied based on the audio tracker. Effectively, we’ve added the Animaze Chatpal procedural behaviors for real-time use with audio tracking.
[/list]

[h3]Editor Changelog[/h3]
[list]
[*]updated the MToon shader for VRM 1.0, newly imported VRM 1.0 avatars should be shaded correctly now.

notes.content:
[b]Holotech Studios[/b] is taking you one step closer to the [b]Metaverse[/b] with the [b]1.0 launch of Animaze[/b]. As the successor to FaceRig, today’s Animaze launch brings new features and updates to the software, including [b]a full Twitch integration[/b]. It’s just one more way for us to push the limits of Vtubing!

[previewyoutube=T3vt_RryChE;full][/previewyoutube]

During the Early Access period, we had the opportunity to examine how Vtubers use Animaze. Based on these observations and feedback from the community, we made sure to provide different options for different types of users, including a [b]free-to-use option for casual users[/b] and [b]a premium experience for more professional users[/b].  And now, over [b]30 updates,[/b] [b]15 brand new avatars[/b], and countless exciting partnerships, and one year later, we’re prepared to bring our best selves to the game and present [b]Animaze 1.0[/b]! This is still just the beginning for Animaze, and you should continue to expect more updates from us in 2021 and onwards.

Here is a brief view of all the improvements we brought, compared to our predeceasing app, FaceRig:

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38657414/cd2290bc1cafd250544e8b33037b074698e0249a.jpg[/img]

And now it’s time for the changes we want to present to you today. [b]We’re extremely excited to present to you[/b]: 

[list]
[*] [b]Twitch Integration[/b]: This new feature gives Animaze a whole new level of interactivity and entertainment to avatar streaming! This new feature allows streamers to automatically trigger avatar animations, voice effects, emotes and more based on audience interactions such as subs, follows, keywords in chat, and raids. We’ve also put together a [url=https://www.animaze.us/faq/tech/twitch]guide on how to set it up right here[/url]. 

[previewyoutube=1yREUiONWOo;full][/previewyoutube]

[*] [b]PNGs as emotes[/b]: Get ready to let all your emotions free on your streams with Animaze’s new feature that allows you to import whatever png files you want to use as emotes in your streams and videos! 
Find everything you need to know to take advantage of this awesome new feature in [url=https://www.animaze.us/faq/tech/pngemote]our manual here.[/url] 

[previewyoutube=bWHhXe51FlQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[*][b]Ultraleap Gemini integration[/b]: Animaze now supports the fifth generation of the Ultraleap Gemini hand-tracking. This tracker matches the position of your virtual hands to your real ones more closely than ever before. 

[previewyoutube=Llvh4GBpnVA;full][/previewyoutube]

[*][b]Background customizations[/b]: We’ve added a new flow to open new creative prospects for your streams. Use the blur slider to add depth, the tint background option with a color of your choice to quickly repurpose backgrounds, or the solid color background selector to change the background image to a solid color of your choice. You can find more information about this in [url=https://www.animaze.us/faq/tech/customizedbkg]our dedicated article[/url].

[*][b]Update translations for all the Animaze products[/b]: The Animaze Desktop app, Animaze iOS app, and the Animaze Editor have updated versions in[b] Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Russian, Brazilian Portuguese, and Spanish[/b]! We’re working really hard to update our documentation into Japanese at the moment, so there’s more to come! 

[*][b]EULA update [/b]- We updated our EULA at the request of our partner, Live2D. As with all 3rd party extendable applications that support VTubing with Live2D avatars, if you earn more than 20 million Yen per year, Live2D requires a separate publication agreement and fee with Live2D. This EULA update applies only to Live2D model users.

notes.title: Hotfix 2 for build 1.25.7545

There are reports of the Animaze Virtual Camera rendering at very low FPS (~1 FPS). The low FPS is mainly due to the "offline" splash screen (when Animaze is not broadcasting).

What happens under the hood is Animaze dynamically sets the refresh rate (e.g., 1 FPS for the offline splash screen, 30 FPS in normal scenarios, and 60 FPS for Plus & VIP subscribers). However, the applications that use the Animaze virtual camera don’t dynamically refresh to change the FPS. So, with this update, we set the offline splash screen FPS to 30,  but need everyone with this issue post-update to follow these steps:

Go to the program where you are using the Animaze virtual camera (e.g., OBS, Discord, Zoom)
Go to settings in that program 
Close or disable the camera  
Reopen or enable the camera using Animaze Virtual camera

As is always the case, if you encounter any issues please let us know on our Discord server:  https://animaze.tv/discord  or via our support email: support[at]animaze.us.

notes.title: v1.25.7032: Backgrounds with Overlays, Personas, Audio-Based Lipsync, and more!
notes.content:
Hi Animaze Community!

[h3]Today’s release introduces 4 amazing new features: Personas, Backgrounds with Overlays, Lighting Customizations, and 2 forms of audio-based lipsync![/h3]

[h3][u][b]Backgrounds with Overlays (and Animations)!:[/b][/u][/h3] Use new backgrounds that include elements both in front of and behind your avatar. Place your avatar in a podcast booth, a streaming setup (with gaming chair and microphone), and more without having to create custom images or setup layers in OBS!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657414/5bb5ab5c714cf559d1580afdd0af0865a3fc9261.png[/img]

These new backgrounds also support animated elements powered by Live2D, including:
[list]
[*] Loopable animations integrated into the background 
[*] Background elements linked to your avatar’s movements
[*] Special actions that trigger visual changes in the background
[/list]

Check out these new backgrounds with overlays to drop your avatar into a variety of scenes with 1 click! We are releasing an update to the Animaze Editor in a few days that allows you to create your very own backgrounds with overlays. More information can be found [url=https://www.animaze.us/faq/animazedesktop/overlaybackgrounds]here[/url].

[h3][u][b]Personas: [/b][/u][/h3]Easily create your very own human avatar within Animaze! Customize your Persona by selecting from a wide variety of facial features like hairstyles, eye shape, skin tone, and clothing! This is our very first release of Personas on PC, so let us know what you think! More information available [url=https://www.animaze.us/faq/animazedesktop/desktoppersonas]here[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657414/d7a244c09ab034fee6092b5f9c5b58bd2934ee20.png[/img]

[h3][u][b]Lighting Customization:[/b][/u][/h3] Customize the lighting in each one of your backgrounds to give your avatar a unique look that matches their setting! Use one of 7 presets (including Cyberpunk, Hell, or 3 point light), or create your own custom lighting setup with up to 4 lights. Control color and intensity to bring your settings to life! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657414/5a15dd3c73d215aaa3b5edd92bdfbc8f021d700e.jpg[/img]

[h3][u][b]Audio Based Lip-Sync (Subscriber-only Feature):[/b][/u][/h3] All Plus and VIP subscribers now have access to not one, but two types of audio-based lip sync! Audio based lip sync uses advanced sound processing to animate your avatar’s mouth to match the sound of your speech. Use audio based lip sync in conjunction with your webcam to get even more accurate mouth animations, or on it’s own to animate your avatar’s mouth if you don’t have a webcam! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657414/ef1f6a7ecd0e0d5d9b6bed28f25083c0c36f4b49.png[/img]

Go to [b]Animaze → Settings → Advanced Tracking Configuration[/b] to enable either audio-based lipsync option (only one can be enabled at a time)

[list]
[*] Complex: Best for 3D avatars, or 2D avatars with detailed facial rigs.
[*] Simple: Best for 2D avatars (uses less resources than complex tracker)
[/list]

Here’s a list of smaller fixes and updates included in today’s build:
[list]
[*] Most panels (e.g. Avatar & Prop galleries) are now resizable
[*] Added a ‘Headphones’ category for props - you can now use headphones and an additional hat item at the same time!
[*] Added new backgrounds, props, and voice effects
[*] Added a button in Settings → Video Graphics called ‘Open Advanced Camera Dialog.’ If you have a 60FPS-capable webcam (such as a Logitech c920 series), click this button and disable the ‘low light compensation’ option to unlock 60FPS within Animaze.
[*] Default webcam settings will select the highest FPS supported by your webcam
[*] Avatar position and rotation are no longer reset after saving customizations
[*] Tweaks and improvements to physics
[*] Fixed a crash when removing and re-attaching props
[*] Fixed crash related to iPhone bridge connection
[*] Fixed multiple crashes related to props
[*] Lots of under the hood fixes, tweaks, and optimizations! 
[/list]

Let us know what you think about all the new features, and tell us what you’d like to see added to Animaze next! Join our [u][b][url=animaze.tv/discord]Discord server[/url][/b][/u], email us at [u][b]support@animaze.us[/b][/u], or message us on [u][b][url=animaze.tv/twitter]Twitter[/url][/b][/u]!

Happy Streaming,
The Holotech Team

[u]Known Issues:[/u]

[list]
[*] Audio-based lip sync does not work if you are broadcasting with the virtual camera [b][u]and [/u][/b]you have the Animaze Virtual Microphone installed on your PC (e.g. for voice effects). You do not have the Animaze Virtual Microphone installed unless you have manually navigated to the Animaze\Bin\prerequisites\AnimazeVirtualMicrophone folder and double clicked the install.bat file. This issue will be fixed in a future update.
[*] Personas do not support hats and headphones. FYI - we will be adding more clothing options in future updates.
[*] Modifying the textures on default hairstyles on personas doesn't get saved. We will be working on a fix in future updates. For now, we have the following work around: change the hairstyle and go back to the default one. After this go change the texture and then go back to the style you wanted.
[/list]

notes.title: The Animaze Virtual Background Contest is Here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657414/5069c32fbb6a245cf3171c99654350c00b981916.png[/img]

[h2]Contest Overview[/h2]

Hello and welcome artists, illustrators, streamers, and content creators! To celebrate the launch of Animaze, [b]we’ve teamed up with our friends at Live2D to bring you the Animaze Virtual Background Contest.[/b] We’re giving YOU the opportunity to win awesome prizes by creating your own virtual backgrounds for Animaze avatars and sharing them on Twitter! 

[h3]5 winners will receive a $100 Steam Gift Card and have their background featured in Animaze![/h3]

[u][b]Here’s How it Works:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] [b]Create your own virtual background[/b] with your favorite illustration or graphics editing software (and test it in Animaze!). Your background can be any original 2D creation - a scene/setting, a cool graphic design, or even a stylized photograph. 
[*] [b]Follow [url=twitter.com/animazefacerig]@animazefacerig[/url] and [url=twitter.com/live2d]@Live2D[/url] on Twitter, then share your virtual background on Twitter with the hashtags #MyAnimazeBackground and #contest between November 24 and December 15[/b] to enter. Even better if you share a screenshot of your background with an Animaze avatar on top!
[*] [b]5 winners (chosen by Holotech & Live2D) will have their virtual backgrounds featured in Animaze and receive a $100 Steam gift card![/b]
[*] On December 21, we’ll announce the winners!
[*] NOTE: You must be a resident of Japan or the USA to enter
[/list]

We look forward to seeing great inspiring works from all of you! Go get creative and amaze with Animaze!

If you have any questions about the contest or Animaze in general, join our [u][b][url=https://animaze.tv/discord]Discord server[/url][/b][/u], @ us on [u][b][url=twitter.com/animazefacerig]Twitter[/url][/b][/u], or email us at [u][b]support@animaze.us[/b][/u]

Read on for detailed information about the contest!

Thanks, 
Holotech Studios & Live2D


[h2]Contest FAQ and More Information:[/h2]

[u][b]What is a Virtual Background?[/b][/u]
Every Animaze avatar needs a virtual background - the scenery or backdrop on which an avatar is displayed. In Animaze, you can use ANY 2D image or illustration as a virtual background. Virtual backgrounds can include scenes or settings (such as an office, outer space, or a sunny field), graphic designs, or anything else you can imagine. Make sure you design your virtual backgrounds with an avatar in mind!

[u][b]Virtual Background Example:[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657414/0ca2ab149c712f282a0ee32038dec4b97917d020.png[/img]

[u][b]Animaze Avatar on a Virtual Background:[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657414/0bd51a6ce35893f0bd6519e7365a2cb6a6534627.png[/img]

[u][b]How do I Enter the Virtual Background Contest?[/b][/u]

All you have to do is follow [u][b][url=animaze.tv/twitter]@animazefacerig[/url][/b][/u] and [u][b][url=twitter.com/Live2D][u][b]@Live2D[/b][/u][/url][/b][/u] on Twitter, create your own original virtual background, and share it from your Twitter account with the hashtags #MyAnimazeBackground and #Contest. Virtual background submissions should be .png files with dimensions of 1920 x 1080 pixels. To verify the originality of your submissions, we may ask you to provide source files for your virtual backgrounds as well.

[u][b]When Should I Post my Submissions On Twitter?[/b][/u]

Submissions must be posted to Twitter with the hashtag #MyAnimazeBackground and #Contest between Tuesday November 24th (6PM GMT +3) and Tuesday December 15th, 2020 (6PM GMT +3) to be eligible to win.

[u][b]What should my Virtual Background Look Like?[/b][/u]

It’s completely up to you! Just let your creativity takeover and design a background that you would like thousands of people to use on Animaze. You can create your virtual background submissions in whatever illustration, photography, or image creation program you prefer (e.g. Illustrator, Photoshop, GIMP). Submissions can utilize any art style and creative direction. We recommend that you design your background with avatars in mind and test your backgrounds in Animaze while you’re working on them! 

[u][b]What Prizes Can I Win?[/b][/u]
5 winners will have their virtual backgrounds featured within Animaze (with attribution), on a special shelf showcasing the winning submissions! These winners will get their work in front of thousands of Animaze users who can entertain others by broadcasting the winning virtual backgrounds in their avatar streams and video chats. 

Winners will also receive a $100 Steam gift card. These individuals will be selected by Holotech and Live2D based on judgements of the backgrounds’ originality, design quality, and usability.

[u][b]When Will Winners Be Announced?[/b][/u]
The winners will be announced on the official Animaze Twitter account (@animazefacerig) on Monday, December 21st. Winners will be contacted via Direct Message on Twitter after the close of the entry period.

Additional Submission & Design Guidelines:

[list]
[*] You must be a resident of the United States or Japan to enter
[*] Submissions must be static 2D images (.png or JPEG) in 16:9 aspect ratio with a minimum resolution of 1920 x 1080 pixels.
[*] Multiple entries are allowed - create and submit as many works as you’d like! However, each submitter can only win once.
[*] You may collaborate with others on your work.  Only 1 prize will be awarded to a winning submission regardless of how many people created it
[*] Submissions must come from public Twitter accounts to be eligible to win. We must be able to see your post to count it.
[*] Submissions must be original works. Reusing or submitting others’ work is not allowed.
[*] Submissions must be posted during the entry period to be eligible to win
[*] Selected winners must promptly respond to Twitter direct messages informing you that you have won. If you do not respond promptly, your prize may be forfeited and awarded to another submission.
[*] You cannot transfer or give the winning rights to a third party.
[*] If your Twitter account is deleted or inaccessible when winners are announced, you will not be eligible.
[*] By posting a submission with the hashtag #MyAnimazeBackground, you acknowledge the indefinite right of Holotech Inc. and Live2D Inc. to use it in Animaze as a virtual background as well as for publicity of this contest.
[*] See our full terms and conditions here: [url=https://animaze.tv/33afV6l]https://animaze.tv/33afV6l[/url]
[/list]

Keep in mind that Animaze is an evergreen platform, and we’ll continue adding exciting new features - as well as new avatars and props - long past v1.0.

notes.title: Post-Beta Update: New Features, Subscription Tweaks and Extended FaceRig Support
notes.content:
Hi Awesome People,
 
THANK YOU to everyone who signed up for or participated in our closed beta! Now that we’ve had some time to pour over all of your feedback, we’d like to share a number of changes and updates we are making to Animaze (and FaceRig) as a result of the beta. 
 
[h1][u]Extending FaceRig Support:[/u][/h1]
 
First of all - [b]we are extending critical product support and customer support for FaceRig through December 31, 2021[/b]. Critical product support means that if any external factor (such as a Windows Update) causes FaceRig to be unusable for a large percentage of people, we will do everything in our power to fix it. In simple terms, [b]we will make sure that FaceRig remains functional through the end of 2021[/b]. It’s incredibly important to us that everyone can continue using FaceRig without worrying about a sudden unexpected event disabling the program. 
 
On the customer support side, you can continue to contact us through the usual channels (email, [url=animaze.tv/discord]Discord[/url], and [url=twitter.com/facerig]Twitter [/url]are best) if you need help with FaceRig. Response time for issues relating to FaceRig may take up to 5 business days in some cases, but we are guaranteeing direct assistance through the end of 2021. 
 
[h1][u]FaceRig Going Away Sale:[/u][/h1]
 
Many of you asked if FaceRig will go on sale one last time before we remove it from stores. The answer is yes! [b]We are going to have a Going Away Sale on Steam with significant discounts on the base FaceRig software and all DLCs[/b] (including Pro and avatar packs) before Animaze launches. Stay tuned for more details on date and time.
 
[h1][u]Animaze Product Updates:[/u][/h1]
 
During our beta, we got a huge amount of valuable feedback from our testers. As a result, we are adding the following features to Animaze prior to launch:
 
[h3]New Features for All Users:[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b][u]Prop Placement Controls[/u][/b]: Adjust props to make them fit your avatar just right. In addition to scaling and customizing the look of your props, you’ll be able to move props along the XYZ axes and rotate them in multiple directions.
[*] [b][u]Streamlined Live2D Imports & FaceRig Conversions[/u][/b]: Import any Live2D avatar made with Cubism 3.0 or higher (including avatars you used with FaceRig) directly in Animaze, without having to use the Animaze Editor. Most avatars imported this way will not require any updates or changes. In short, this means that [i]virtually everyone with a Cubism 3.0+ Live2D model, whether originally made for FaceRig or some other software, will be able to use it in Animaze without any assistance from a Live2D artist[/i]. All you need are your Live2D runtime files. If you do need to debug or fix your avatar, we’ve built new features into the Animaze Editor allowing anyone to fix common issues.
[*][b] [u]Embodiment, Tracking, and Calibration Improvements[/u][/b]: We’re always working under the hood to improve the quality of the overall avatar experience. During the beta, you all helped us identify a number of issues and improvements relating to embodiment, calibration, and tracking. You’ll see better results overall when Animaze launches! 
[/list]

[h3]New Features for Basic Subscribers:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b][u]Advanced Embodiment Controls[/u][/b]: Fine tune how your avatar responds to your facial movements and customize a configuration that works best for you. Includes an auto-blink toggle!
[*] [b][u]Secondary Render Window with Alpha Channel Transparency[/u][/b]: If you prefer to capture an app window rather than use the virtual webcam when you stream, you can enable a secondary render window that displays your avatar and background without any visible UI. We will also enable the usage of Alpha Channel transparency, so you can have more reliable “green screen” effects without chroma key artifacts on a variety of avatars. Remember, if you are using the free version of Animaze. you can still capture the entire app window (or a specific portion of the window) and send that to OBS or your preferred streaming software. You can also use a traditional green screen in any version of Animaze.
[/list] 

What’s included here is not an exhaustive list of changes, improvements, and new features coming to Animaze at launch. These are simply the most significant changes we are making directly in response to feedback from the beta. 
 
[h1][u]Animaze Subscription Updates:[/u] [/h1]
 
We received a lot of feedback on Animaze subscriptions. We understand that subscriptions are a frequently discussed and at times hotly debated topic. Before we share some changes that we’re making to our subscriptions from the beta, I’d like to highlight a few [b]core principles of our approach to Animaze’s business model[/b]:
 
[b][u]Free Access:[/u][/b] Animaze is free to download, can be used forever without a subscription, and will improve over time as we roll out new features and content. It’s important to us that everyone, and especially those of you who have invested in FaceRig, can evaluate Animaze on its own merits and decide if a subscription is worth it to you. If not, you can keep using the free version of Animaze, FaceRig, or another product that fits your needs. 
 
[b][u]Affordable Pricing:[/u][/b] Our subscriptions are amongst the lowest-cost offerings available, especially when you look at other avatar, artist, and content creator products. At $19.99/year, Animaze’s basic subscription nets out to just $1.67 per month. 
 
Here’s a look at that annual cost compared to other subscription products you might use or be familiar with: 
 
[list]
[*] 13% the cost of a Streamlabs annual subscription ($149/year vs. $19.99/year)
[*] 13% the cost of a Zoom annual subscription ($149/year vs. $19.99/year)
[*] 8% of a Photoshop-only annual subscription ($239.88/year vs. $19.99/year)
[/list]
 
Subscription costs will be even lower for those of you that own FaceRig, since you’ll automatically get substantial discounts on Animaze subscriptions. 
 
[b][u]Consistent Updates and Communication:[/u][/b] Animaze will receive much more consistent and meaningful updates than you’ve seen in the last few years of FaceRig’s lifetime. We’re already hard at work building new features, new avatars, new props, and support for new content formats. We’ll be sharing roadmap information and engaging in consistent dialog with the community to ensure we’re building what you want. We’ve had a great start engaging with thousands of testers during our beta! 
 
With that said, [b]here are the changes we’re making to Animaze subscriptions before launch[/b]:
 
[b][u]Doubling Virtual Camera Session Time to 90 Minutes in Free Version[/u][/b]: The free version of Animaze will allow you to use the virtual camera to livestream or video chat for 90 minutes at a time (increased from 45). After 90 minutes, you can simply restart Animaze to reset the timer back to zero. Remember, you can stream for an unlimited time by capturing all or part of the application window in your preferred streaming software, regardless of whether you are a subscriber. All subscribers have unlimited session time with the virtual camera. 
 
[b][u]60FPS Output Through Virtual Webcam Moved from VIP to Basic Subscription[/u][/b]: 60 FPS output through the virtual webcam is now included for everyone who has a Basic ($19.99/year) subscription. This feature previously required the VIP ($99.99/year) subscription. As a reminder, 60FPS output is possible for all Animaze versions (including the free version) by capturing all or a portion of the application window. 
 
Here’s what each Animaze subscription will look like at launch. Please note that the VIP subscription is now only for Commercial Rights. We’ve updated our requirements for who needs commercial rights to use Animaze - see below for the details.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657414/975d03a28d6feee919e2727170d29246be62f868.png[/img]
 
[b][u]Commercial Rights Requirements for VIP Subscription[/u][/b]: We’re reverting the Commercial Rights requirements to match what’s currently in place for FaceRig Pro:
 
Individual streamers and content creators who consistently make more than $500 per month from their channel (e.g. from subscriber or ad revenue) need commercial rights to use Animaze. 
If you meet this requirement, you need an Animaze VIP subscription.
 
If you are a business interested in using Animaze, you need an Enterprise License. To inquire about an Enterprise License, contact support@animaze.us.
 
Here are the new Commercial Rights requirements in full:
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657414/f132c335dd0d803fe9f33a1c56015f819f020c3c.png[/img]
 
[h1][u]Animaze Launch Timing:[/u][/h1]
 
We know you are eager to learn when Animaze will launch. While we don’t have a launch date yet, [b]we are working as hard as we possibly can to launch Animaze into Early Access on Steam before the end of 2020. [/b] If you haven't already, wishlist Animaze now to be notified when we launch!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1364390/

Stay tuned for more information, including a definitive launch date, in the coming weeks!
 
As always, you can reach us on email, [url=animaze.tv/discord]Discord[/url], and [url=twitter.com/facerig]Twitter [/url]with questions and/or comments.
 
All the Best,
The FaceRig/Animaze Team

notes.title: Introducing Animaze, the Official Successor to FaceRig
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to share that [b]Animaze, our new PC program and the official successor to FaceRig, is coming soon to Steam[/b]! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1364390/Animaze_by_FaceRig/

[list]
[*] [url=https://animaze.tv/steam][b]Wishlist Animaze on Steam[/b][/url]

[*] [url=https://www.animaze.us/news][b]Read the full announcement[/b][/url] on our new website
[*] [url=https://animaze.tv/discord][b]Join our Discord server[/b][/url] to chat with us directly! 
[/list]

[previewyoutube=ABcsq2Wvhcc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]What is Animaze?[/h1]

Like FaceRig, Animaze makes it easy to stream, video chat, and record videos as awesome avatars. Thanks to years of R&D (and thoughtful feedback from you), Animaze brings major improvements to every core aspect of FaceRig.[b] Face tracking, animation, and graphics have all been completely redesigned[/b] to deliver more expressive avatars than ever before!

We want Animaze to be accessible to everyone. That’s why [b]Animaze will be free to download and use with optional subscriptions for premium features[/b]. There will also be in-app currency to spend on new avatars, props, and backgrounds. You can use Animaze for free forever; it is not a ‘trial’ and access never expires. If you decide to subscribe, the cost will be affordable: a few dollars per month for most folks, or a little bit more for professional content creators. If you already own FaceRig, you’ll automatically receive a discount on any Animaze subscription you decide to purchase. 

Plus - when Animaze launches on Steam, [b]FaceRig owners will get all sorts of special rewards, including exclusive props, free avatars, and discounts![/b]

[h1]What will Happen to FaceRig?[/h1]

[b]If you own a copy of FaceRig, you can continue using it without interruption in perpetuity. [/b]This applies to all copies of FaceRig - whether you obtained it through Steam, a Steam key reseller like Humble Bundle/Fanatical, or directly from Holotech via our website. It includes all versions of FaceRig (Classic & Studio), as well as all DLC content and upgrades (e.g. Live2D module, FaceRig Pro, avatar packs). Our number one priority is to do right by you in this process. Many of you have supported us since the very beginning of our journey, and we want you to be able to continue using FaceRig for as long as you want to, regardless of whether you decide to check out Animaze.

That said, FaceRig will not receive any additional feature/content updates or bug fixes; the current version of FaceRig is its final form. [b]When we release Animaze, we will remove all versions of FaceRig, including upgrades & DLC packs, from sale everywhere. The Facerig Steam Forums and Steam Workshop will continue to function as normal.[/b] As we shift our focus to Animaze, our support priorities have to change too. When Animaze launches, we will no longer be able to provide customer support for issues relating to FaceRig. If you run into issues with FaceRig, we recommend you check our FAQs, Steam Forums, and Discord channel for help.

Please Note: [b]You will still be able to re-download FaceRig if you uninstall it or would like to download FaceRig to a new device.[/b] If you acquired FaceRig through Steam, either directly or through a code or gift, simply re-download it via your Steam library. If you purchased FaceRig directly from our website, email us at support@animaze.us and we can help you regain access.

[h1]Have Additional Questions?[/h1]

We have a lot of answers! For detailed information check out our [url=https://www.animaze.us/news]full announcement on our new website[/url] and [url=https://animaze.tv/discord][b]join our Discord server[/b][/url] to chat with us directly! You can always email us at support@animaze.us.

Your Friends,
The FaceRig/Animaze Team
